text:
alex: heads-up hitting a nasty edge in the starter app: model streamed two JSON docs in the same response and our JS sdk choked when json_mode was enabled. demo crashed during onboarding.

alex: raw chunk from the stream:
```
{"action":"lookup","user_id":42}
{"error":"not_found","code":404}
```

alex: crash was a JSON.parse on the whole stream in sdk/jsonparser.js — we assume a single root.

mira: yep that's the multi-document streaming case. python sdk has a tolerant iterator that parses line-delimited JSON; JS never got the parity patch.

sam: related: I hit an auth-retry bug where a 401 triggers the client to retry and the fncall helper re-serializes the tool payload which ends up double-encoded for our tool plugin. Repro: starter-kit oauth flow + flaky auth server.

kim: quick mitigation: set json_mode to "multi_doc" (experimental) for now so parser splits on newlines and processes docs individually. e.g. in JS:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ json_mode: 'multi_doc' });
```
python equivalent: 
```py
client = RedwoodClient(json_mode='multi_doc')
```
This prevents the crash but doesn't solve schema validation ordering.

mira: exactly. multi_doc prevents parse errors but we currently only validate the first doc against the declared schema. We need to: validate each doc in sequence and return a structured list of validation results (or a combined error).

alex: i opened an issue with minimal repro + logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-kit/issues/2410 — includes the prompt and failing request id.

devex-bot: Created issue #2410 in redwood-inference/starter-kit and attached PR template.

sam: local repro command i used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @multi_doc_prompt.json | jq -c .
```
multi_doc_prompt.json instructs the model to emit two separate json objects.

kim: proposed short-term plan:
1) ship JS parser parity to match python tolerant iterator,
2) add json_mode: "validate_all" that validates each doc and returns array of results,
3) add unit tests in starter-kit covering auth-retry + streaming to catch double-encode regressions.

mira: i'll pick up the parser parity. alex, can you paste the minimal prompt and failing request id in the issue so i can add tests?

alex: done, pasted the prompt + request id. thanks.

sam: happy to help QA once there's a branch. :thumbsup:

kim: note — when we flip on validate_all we should gate it behind opt-in initially to avoid surprising existing integrations that expect single-doc behaviour.

mira: agreed. i'll open a draft PR for the JS sdk and tag you all.

alex: closing the loop. please dump any other streaming/fncall weirdness in issue #2410.
